packages.name: pi-web-access
packages.description: Web search, fetch/scrape (Defuddle), YouTube transcripts, and librarian skill for pi.
packages.notes: Installs to ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-web-access. Manifest declares ./index.ts as the extension entry and bundles a skills/ directory (librarian, web-access).

packages.name: context-mode
packages.description: Context-mode: ctx_* tools (sandbox code execution, FTS5 knowledge base, session memory) and the context-mode skill set.
packages.notes: Standalone npm package installed via `pi install`. The build/adapters/pi/extension.js adapter is the pi entry; OpenCode/Claude use different adapters. Bundles the context-mode skills.

packages.name: pi-subagents
packages.description: Subagent delegation for pi: single, chain, parallel, async, and forked-context workflows with intercom coordination.
packages.notes: User shorthand `src/extension` maps to ./src/extension/index.ts. Bundles the pi-subagents skill and prompt templates.

packages.name: @plannotator/pi-extension
packages.description: Plannotator: interactive plan review/editor with a browser UI and event handling for pi.
packages.notes: Package uses `pi.extensions: ["./"]`, so the extension entry is the root index.ts (user shorthand `pi-extension` references the package, not a subpath). Large HTML assets (plannotator.html, review-editor.html) ship in the tarball.

packages.name: @ff-labs/pi-fff
packages.description: pi-fff: fuzzy search / grep tools for pi (ff-find, ff-grep).
packages.notes: User shorthand `src` maps to the manifest entry ./src/index.ts. RTK and headroom are preferred for output compression; pi-fff covers fuzzy path/grep search.

localExtensions.name: variants.ts
localExtensions.description: Claude-style /models picker: model list, ←→ effort, and fast-mode toggle for sibling models (e.g. grok-4.6-fast). Also registers /effort, /fast, /variants.
localExtensions.notes: Repo source: harnesses/pi/variants.ts. Installed by agentfolio apply --profile pi into ~/.pi/agent/extensions/. Auto-discovered by pi; not added to settings.json packages. Adds effort:<level> and fast status chips. Restart pi after install so the commands are registered.

localExtensions.name: xai.ts
localExtensions.description: xAI provider for pi with Grok 4.6, Grok 4.6 Fast, API-key auth, optional xAI device-code OAuth, live model discovery, and pi thinking-level mappings.
localExtensions.notes: Repo source: harnesses/pi/xai.ts. Installs globally as ~/.pi/agent/extensions/xai.ts and registers provider id `xai`. Use XAI_API_KEY or /login xai.

localExtensions.name: env-permissions.ts
localExtensions.description: Permission list that blocks read/write/edit/bash access to .env files.
localExtensions.notes: Repo source: harnesses/pi/env-permissions.ts. Installed by agentfolio apply --profile pi into ~/.pi/agent/extensions/. Auto-discovered by pi. Deny list is PERMISSIONS in the file; optional overlay ~/.pi/agent/extensions/env-permissions.json. Restart pi or /reload after install.

localExtensions.name: claude.ts
localExtensions.description: Claude Code CLI bridge for pi. Uses the official local `claude` command and its own auth; no Claude OAuth tokens are handled by pi.
localExtensions.notes: Repo source: harnesses/pi/claude.ts. Registers provider id `claude-cli`. Run `claude login` separately. The bridge shells out to `claude --print` with safe `--permission-mode plan` defaults.

settings.notes: The /model Scope tab is resolved from harnesses/catalog.yaml plus catalog.lock.json. The All tab still shows every model registered by the xAI extension and generated Cursor provider.

modelProviders.name: cursor
modelProviders.description: Cursor subscription models exposed to pi through an isolated OpenCursor ACP-to-OpenAI-compatible bridge.

cursorBridge.notes: Requires cursor-agent and opencode on PATH plus cursor-agent login. PI_CURSOR_WORKSPACE selects the bridge workspace during setup; defaults to the user home directory. Ports bind to 127.0.0.1 without client authentication, so this assumes a trusted single-user machine. No Cursor credentials are copied into the repo.
